seo.title: Your Company — dental clinic in Tashkent: implants, veneers
seo.description: Pain-free treatment under a microscope, implants, veneers and aligners. Digital diagnostics, a priced treatment plan before we start, 0% instalments.
seo.answer: Your Company is a dental clinic in Tashkent (Mirzo Ulugbek district), open daily. Implants from 4,900,000 UZS per turnkey implant, veneers from 2,800,000 UZS per tooth, caries treatment from 450,000 UZS. First consultation with a 3D scan is 150,000 UZS, and 0% instalments for up to 12 months are available.

listing.description: A website for a dental practice, clinic or aesthetic medicine studio. Light and calm: soft glowing fields, services with “from” prices, doctors, treatment steps and booking.

sections.title: Calm dentistry for the whole family
sections.subtitle: First, 3D diagnostics and a clear plan with a price. Then treatment under a microscope with anaesthesia you won’t feel.

sections.label: The clinic
sections.title: We treat you the way we’d treat our own
sections.text: Six treatment rooms, our own CT scanner and dental lab. Every treatment plan is agreed by a panel of two doctors — you get it in writing with the price and timeline before we start. Class B sterilisation, single-use kits, and a sterilisation record in every patient file.

sections.label: Services
sections.title: Services and prices
sections.intro: Prices are “from”: the exact amount is in your treatment plan after diagnostics, and it doesn’t change along the way.

items.title: Implants
items.text: Straumann and Osstem implants, surgical guides, zirconia crown.

items.title: Veneers
items.text: Ceramic and composite veneers based on a digital smile design.

items.title: Aligners
items.text: Clear aligners instead of braces, with a 3D plan of tooth movement.

items.title: Dental treatment
items.text: Caries, root canals under a microscope, composite restorations.

items.title: Pediatric dentistry
items.text: Getting-to-know-you visit, baby teeth treatment, fissure sealing.

items.title: Professional cleaning
items.text: Ultrasound, Air Flow, polishing and fluoride.

sections.label: How treatment works
sections.title: Four steps to a healthy smile

items.title: Consultation
items.text: Examination, a 3D scan and a conversation about what worries you. 40 minutes.

items.title: A plan with a price
items.text: Two or three treatment options with the total and timeline, in writing.

items.title: Treatment
items.text: Under anaesthesia and a microscope, on days that suit you.

items.title: Follow-up
items.text: Check-ups and cleaning every six months — we’ll remind you.

items.quote: I’ve been afraid of dentists since childhood. Here, for the first time, I got through all my treatment without tears — the doctor explained every step, and I didn’t even notice the injection.
items.author: Nigora

items.quote: I had two implants placed. The price in the plan and on the receipt matched to the last som — that’s rare. Six months later they feel like my own teeth.
items.author: Bakhtiyor

items.quote: My son asks to go for cleanings himself: there are cartoons on the ceiling and a doctor who talks to him, not to me.
items.author: Olga

items.a: No. We apply a numbing gel before the injection and give the anaesthetic slowly with a computer-controlled syringe — you barely feel it. Anxious patients can be treated under sedation.

items.q: How long does an implant take?
items.a: Placing the implant itself takes 30–60 minutes. It takes 3–6 months before the permanent crown, while the implant fuses with the bone. If the bone allows, we fit a temporary crown on the day of placement.
Implants carry the manufacturer’s lifetime warranty, crowns and veneers 5 years, fillings 2 years, provided you have a cleaning every six months. All terms are written into the contract.
Yes, 0% instalments for up to 12 months on treatment from 3,000,000 UZS. Set up at the clinic in 15 minutes with your passport.

items.q: From what age do you see children?
items.a: From age two. The first visit is for getting used to things: the child meets the doctor and the chair, and we don’t treat on that day.

items.q: How much is the first consultation?
items.a: 150,000 UZS, including a 3D scan. If you start treatment with us, this amount is deducted from the cost.
